evidence.source: REM-60 gate split reminder observation status on the panel into five SEPARATE dimensions (source freshness via reminderSourceStatusP, remote sync receipt via reminderReceiptStatusP, capability via reminderCapabilityStatusP, privacy via reminderPrivacyStatusP, and user-device/S5 acceptance via reminderDeviceAcceptanceStatusP) with no single-green-badge masking. A new reminderStatusToneMapP() maps the full eight tones (accepted/stale/pending/missing/projection_invalid/error/unsupported/redacted) from one source, unknown codes fail closed to muted, and each status card dimension renders text + icon + source time + privacy label, so color is never the only meaning. reminderStatusCardHTMLP() renders all five dimensions as one card (wired in render() right after coverageRibbonHTMLP); the 'reminder is working' claim is only true via reminderWorkingClaimP() when source + receipt + capability evidence all hold, otherwise a pending claim names the missing evidence (kaynak_kanit_yok / receipt_kanit_yok / capability_kanit_yok). The status card never carries a raw reminder category, schedule or body, and no reminder preference/localStorage/write path is introduced.
